acceptance.assertion: A candidate_task supersession without operator_context inherits an exact canonical copy of the predecessor operator_intake object, so desired_outcome and digest-bound source identity remain present in the current projection.

A supersession that supplies a new operator_context keeps that new context unchanged rather than merging or replacing it with predecessor evidence; candidate_record refinement behavior remains intact.

After a status-only observed-to-promoted transition, operator-candidate-assess reports the promoted current event with no missing desired_outcome or source fields and preserves the prior source freshness, observed_at and SHA-256.
Candidates whose predecessor has no valid operator_intake object remain without one; the repair does not fabricate source evidence or desired outcomes for legacy records.
Focused Live Register and operator-intake tests plus the complete Bureau test and validation suite pass on the exact reviewed revision.

goal: Prevent status-only candidate_task supersessions from degrading the current candidate projection by deterministically inheriting the predecessor's operator_intake context when no replacement context is supplied, while preserving explicit refinement contexts and all existing identity, catalog and append-only semantics.

does_not_establish: candidate source correctness beyond inherited evidence
automatic repair of historical malformed events
semantic correctness of inherited candidate evidence
future absence of unrelated Live Register defects
metadata.outcome: Bureau PR #1305 made status-only candidate_task supersessions preserve a canonical copy of the predecessor operator_intake context when no replacement context is supplied. Explicit refinements remain authoritative and legacy context absence is not fabricated. The exact head passed 140 focused-module tests, the complete 954-test validation suite under local and GitHub Python matrices, was deployed as immutable Bureau release 93b919e068c0-srcdd1f4afad2fa, and preserved the original Candidate evidence through live event 1944.

evidence.result: ruff passed; 954 tests passed; systemkatalog boundary passed; registry check valid

status-supersession-inherits-context.evidence: Live event 1944 inherited the complete canonical operator_intake object from event 1936 without a replacement context, preserving desired_outcome, request identity, source locator, observed_at and SHA-256.

explicit-refinement-remains-authoritativ.evidence: The inheritance branch executes only when operator_context is None. Existing candidate_record refinement tests prove a supplied replacement desired_outcome and source SHA remain authoritative and are not merged with predecessor evidence.

assessment-remains-complete.evidence: Post-deployment operator-candidate-assess returned event 1944, status promoted, missing_fields empty and the original digest-bound source freshness, observed_at and SHA-256.

legacy-absence-not-fabricated.evidence: The legacy supersession regression asserts operator_intake remains absent when the predecessor does not contain a valid context object.
